# Far Fox

> Far Fox (lovefarfox.com) is a relationship app for long-distance couples. Both partners join one private space and build a daily connection ritual: daily questions, love letters, photo sharing, couple challenges, reunion countdowns, and a shared virtual fox that grows as the couple shows up for each other. It is free to start. The site also offers a free, no-signup couple quiz and a time-zone overlap calculator for couples who live hours apart.

## Product

- [Long-distance relationship app overview](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-relationship-app): what Far Fox does for couples who live apart, with FAQ
- [Free couple quiz](https://lovefarfox.com/couple-quiz): 2-minute quiz both partners take; produces a shareable match reveal
- [Long-distance relationship quiz](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-relationship-quiz): how the quiz works for LDR couples, with FAQ
- [Time zone overlap calculator](https://lovefarfox.com/long-distance-time-zone-calculator): pick two cities, see the hour difference and waking-hour overlap

## Comparisons

- [Far Fox vs other couples apps](https://lovefarfox.com/compare): honest comparisons with Paired, Couple, Between, Lasting, and LokLok, including each competitor's strengths
